evidence_scope: Closed recorded navigation only; no intentional dynamic crossing. Streaming bag, no control commands. Status cycles are separate from deduplicated state runs and command zero episodes.
current_mppi_yaml:
# One 10 Hz whole-body sampling controller; original drivers remain the sinks.
rate_hz: 10.0
deadline_s: 0.095
# Keep rollout + model braking + maximum source age within the 2 s forecast.
horizon: 5
random_samples: 4
base_limits:
  vmax: 0.25
  wmax: 0.35
  accel: 0.25
  angular_accel: 0.80
  track: 0.37
  wheel_v: 0.25
  wheel_a: 0.2975
arm_velocity: [0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15]
arm_acceleration: [0.35, 0.35, 0.35, 0.35, 0.35, 0.35]
# Current posture and the REMANI reference are always candidates as well.
postures:
  - [0.0, 2.4434609528, -1.0471975512, 0.0, 0.2617993878, 0.0]
standby: {}

limits: No pure kernel CPU timer is recorded; solve_ms/planning_elapsed_ms include more than optimization.
Twist/status have no source header; local reject->zero pairing uses same-publisher code and bag adjacency, not exact hardware execution time.
Header h4 false can include exporter cached odometry age not carried in header; no geometry_cache blame without corresponding evidence.
A rejected candidate may have feasible samples, but rejected selected first v is not consistently exported; examples use actual successful nonzero deliveries on either side.
Slow-layer cause of ACTION_ABORT belongs to parallel audit; cancellation statuses are consequences, not 946 independent slow faults.

independent_fast_cycle_budget_evidence.boundary: Planning elapsed is wall duration through planning return, not pure solver CPU. Same-input-map freshness at plan return uses source start + recorded wall duration; latest post-plan map was not checked because this deadline gate ran first. Delivery-deadline rows include actual before_delivery checks showing latest map/dynamic/state fresh.

conclusions.claim: Repeated short stops are actual zero Twist commands published by whole_body_mppi.reject, not only log warnings.
conclusions.evidence: All 4453 cmd_vel messages callerid whole_body_mppi; navigation348 zero-transition episodes, with adjacent rejected cycles and nonzero delivered velocities.

conclusions.claim: Most pre-cancellation failures already happen with no intentional dynamic obstacle and feasible nominal candidates.
conclusions.evidence: Before first abort:78 delivered versus40 capture map failures,21 postplan map expiry,16 final input expiry,13 delivery deadline,5 plan deadline.

conclusions.claim: A separate map-cache decode error was escalated into tracking fault and first slow-layer abort.
conclusions.evidence: 1794830579.7247643 delta cache mismatch -> .7262704 tracking_fault true -> .7294927 FSM tracking abort log -> .7353747 ACTION_ABORT.

conclusions.claim: The default 95ms budget is below100ms period but not always attainable; delivery checks add separate cost.
No arm stop latch explains navigation-wide stutter.
conclusions.evidence: 20186 piper execution states,0 stop_latched true;5 transient invalid feedback rows around20:03:05,distinct from first abort.

expiry_gate_classification.limit: h4 is computed upstream using cache validity and cached odometry age as well as timestamps; header does not carry cached odometry stamp. A h4-only rejection cannot be attributed exactly without export diagnostics. cached joint age above250ms at a later gate is only a possible contributor to earlier h4 invalidation.

provenance_boundary: Source SHA recorded at analysis time; actual runtime parameters and bag messages are recorded evidence. Complete binary/library provenance is outside this MPPI stream audit.
